statement: What the chain holds for an Account (its collateral and ondelta, per token, from the Depository's AccountSettled) reaches each hosted party as j_collateral, once per token, in the chain's order and only at the confirmation depth; the Entity sets the ledger's collateral and ondelta to those amounts, on its committed state and on a pending frame's state, and changes no other field; the amounts are a state, so a repeat changes nothing. A log of an AccountSettled that is not one settlement of whole six-word rows is a fault.
source: plan/contracts-decisions.md R-J-COLLATERAL; D9; R-J1 (chain facts reach an Account only through J events); spec/QUESTIONS.md Q-D-22 (a deposit moves collateral and a Left deposit moves ondelta)

layers.arrival: owed: spec thread (the entity page takes j_epoch and j_dispute as J events; j_collateral has no page yet)
layers.quint: owed: spec thread (the Quint model keeps collateral and ondelta in the ledger and moves them by deposit and withdrawal actions, not by a chain snapshot)
layers.contract: n/a: no contract code takes part; the Depository's AccountSettled is what is read
layers.rig: owed: test rig (a walk predicate for this rule; none is named yet)

killers.name: R-J-COLLATERAL the chain's collateral and ondelta are set as they stand; a repeat changes nothing
R-J-COLLATERAL one token's snapshot leaves the other tokens and the off-chain fields as they were
R-J-COLLATERAL an Account the Entity does not hold is told and ignored
R-J-COLLATERAL what the chain holds is what a payment may spend: Left pays from its deposit
R-J-COLLATERAL a frame in flight when the chain is heard commits with the chain's amounts
R-J-COLLATERAL what the chain holds for an Account reaches the Entity's ledger, and a restart's
R-J-COLLATERAL the real deposit and settlement read the collateral and ondelta the contract stored
R-J-COLLATERAL an AccountSettled is its entities and what it holds per token, an Int512 as words
R-J-COLLATERAL an AccountSettled of a shape the Depository does not emit is a fault
R-J-COLLATERAL an AccountSettled is a j_collateral per token for each hosted party, no reading needed
R-J-COLLATERAL the snapshots of one Account stay in the chain's order among its other events
